_note: Invented SMS conversations for staging. {first} = the lead's invented first name. role 'user' = customer/cleaner, 'assistant' = Maids in Black. No real people, numbers or addresses.

new_booking: Hi, do you have anything this Friday for a 2 bed 2 bath?
Hi {first}! Yes, we have a 10am or 1pm arrival window this Friday. A standard clean for 2 bed / 2 bath is $165. Which works best?
You're booked for Friday with a 10–12 arrival window. We'll text you when your team is on the way!
I'd like to book a deep clean before my parents visit next week
Happy to help, {first}! How many bedrooms and bathrooms, and which day works for you?
Wednesday 9am is open. A deep clean for 3 bed / 2 bath is $310 including inside the fridge and oven. Shall I lock it in?
Done! Wednesday 9–11am arrival. You'll get a reminder the day before.
Can I get a cleaning tomorrow afternoon?
Hi {first}, we have one spot tomorrow at 2pm. Is it a standard clean? How many bedrooms?
Great, that's $120. You're booked for tomorrow 2–4pm arrival.
quote: How much for a move-out clean? 2 bed 1 bath apartment
Hi {first}! A move-out clean for 2 bed / 1 bath is $245 and includes inside cabinets, fridge and oven. What date are you moving out?
End of the month, let me check with my landlord
Sounds good, just reply here when you have a date and we'll hold a spot for you.
What do you charge for a regular cleaning?
Hi {first}, it depends on the size of your home. How many bedrooms and bathrooms?
A standard clean is $225, and every two weeks it drops to $195 per visit. Want me to send available times?
We have Monday 9am, Tuesday 1pm or Thursday 10am. Any of those work?
Quote for 3 bed 2.5 bath plus inside windows?
Hi {first}! That's $195 for the clean plus $40 for inside windows, $235 total. Would you like to book?
That's a bit more than I expected, I'll think about it
No problem at all. The quote is good for 14 days, just reply whenever you're ready.
reschedule: Something came up, can we move Thursday's cleaning?
Of course, {first}. We can do Friday at 10am or Monday at 1pm. Which is better?
All set, you're moved to Monday with a 1–3pm arrival window. Thursday is cancelled.
Can the team come an hour later tomorrow?
Let me check with the team, {first}. One moment.
Good news, they can arrive between 11am and 1pm instead. I've updated your booking.
I need to reschedule, I'll be traveling next week
Safe travels, {first}! Would the following week work? We have Tuesday or Wednesday morning.
Done, you're booked for Wednesday 9–11am. Enjoy your trip!
cancellation: I need to cancel my cleaning on Saturday
Sorry to hear that, {first}. I've cancelled Saturday's visit. Would you like to pick a new date?
No problem, we're here whenever you need us.
Please cancel my recurring cleanings, I'm moving out of the area
Thanks for letting us know, {first}, and best of luck with the move! Your recurring visits are cancelled. Need a move-out clean before you go?
Actually yes, how much would that be?
For your home it's $275. We have next Saturday open if that helps.
Hi {first}, just to confirm, would you like to cancel your booking on the 14th?
Your booking on the 14th has been cancelled. Thank you!
complaint: The team missed the kitchen floor and the bathroom mirror today
I'm really sorry, {first}. That's not our standard. We'd like to send the team back to fix it free of charge. Would tomorrow morning work?
Booked for 9am tomorrow at no charge. Thank you for telling us, and sorry again.
The cleaner arrived almost 2 hours late
I apologize, {first}. There was a delay at the previous job and we should have let you know sooner. I've applied a $25 credit to your next clean.
Ok thanks, please just text me next time
Absolutely, we've added a note to always text you if the team is running late.
I think a vase was broken during the clean
I'm so sorry, {first}. Could you send a photo? We'll make this right.
Thank you, we received it. Our manager will call you today to arrange a replacement.
recurring: Can we set up cleanings every two weeks?
Definitely, {first}! Every two weeks on Wednesdays at 10am works for your team. Your rate becomes $175 per visit.
You're all set for every other Wednesday starting next week.
Can I switch from monthly to weekly?
Of course, {first}. Weekly visits are $150 each. Same day and time as now?
Updated! You're now weekly on Mondays at 1pm.
Can I skip next week's recurring clean?
No problem, {first}. Next week is skipped and your regular schedule resumes the week after.
cleaner_coordination: Hi {first}, you're scheduled tomorrow at 9am and 1pm. Please confirm.
Thanks! The 1pm client asked for extra attention on the oven.
I'm running about 20 minutes late, traffic is bad
Thanks for the heads up, {first}. I'll let the client know you'll arrive around 10:20.
Finished the 9am job, the client wasn't home so I locked up as instructed
Great work, {first}. Please upload the after photos when you can.
general: Do you bring your own supplies?
Hi {first}! Yes, our teams bring all supplies and equipment. If you prefer eco-friendly products just let us know.
Yes, {first}, we clean on Saturdays from 9am to 5pm. Would you like to book a Saturday visit?
Hi, is this Maids in Black?
Hi {first}, yes it is! How can we help you today?
I'll call you later about a quote
